input_contract.row_unit: one frozen run-clean local sibling pair
input_contract.truth_sign: plus1 iff canonical-left has strictly higher pristine external score, minus1 otherwise; exact score ties are excluded before this kernel
input_contract.pair_and_cluster_identifiers: lowercase sha256 only; no raw task parent run or endpoint identity

aggregation: compute pair credit separately for every seeded checkpoint
within task average the three seed-specific differences
average task differences with equal task weight
primary_estimand.tfidf_pairing: subtract the one frozen same-pool tfidf credit from each full-model seed before seed averaging

task_cluster_interval.method: deterministic nonparametric percentile bootstrap over task effects

primary_estimand.leave_one_task_out: equal-task effect after dropping each task
primary_estimand.single_task_correct_difference_share: maximum positive unnormalised pair-by-seed correct-credit gain from one task divided by the sum of positive task gains

local_repeat_confound.failure_interpretation: full may avoid repeated-local overtraining but global-to-local transfer is not established

stop_rules: reject duplicate pairs non-sha identifiers nonfinite margins missing arms or score ties
authenticate every checkpoint and the complete prediction escrow before an outcome-aware caller constructs rows
do not alter aggregation bootstrap hierarchy thresholds or task support after outcome opening
this statistics kernel does not itself authorize or implement label-vault opening
